body:
These are places in the **A. P. de Zoysa** Sinhala translation of the Aṅguttara Nikāya (Eights) that look like errors, found while reading the translation beside the Pāli.

Each item gives the paragraph number and sutta heading as the file gives them, and a **fix** link that opens the line on GitHub (the pencil icon there edits it). Then: **Now** (copied from that line), **Should be**, **Why**, and lines from your own files to **compare**. If an earlier fix has moved the line, the search text finds it. Some items may be our misunderstanding; corrections are welcome. Please tick an item when it is fixed, or reply with its ID.

- [ ] **PLK-175** · paragraph 36 (පුඤ්ඤකිරියවත්‍ථු සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3313.xml line 81](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3313.xml#L81)
  - Now: “මහණෙනි, මේ ලෝකයෙහි ඇතැමෙකු විසින් දානමය පුණ්‍ය ක්‍රියා වස්තුව අධික ප්‍රමාණයක්
  - Should be: Delete lines 81 and 82: they repeat lines 79 and 80 word for word (the Cātumahārājika case). Line 83 (the Tāvatiṃsa case) should follow line 80 directly.
  - Why: The case of rebirth among the Cātumahārājika gods and the paragraph on the Four Great Kings are given twice in a row. The Pāli gives this case once and then goes on to the Tāvatiṃsa gods.
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta, case 3 (given once) ([an-8.json line 6082](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L6082)): පරම්මරණා චාතුම්මහාරාජිකානං
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta, case 4, next ([an-8.json line 6086](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L6086)): පරම්මරණා තාවතිංසානං දෙවානං
  - Compare, line 79, the same text as line 81 ([vagga_3313.xml line 79](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3313.xml#L79)): භාවනාමය පුණ්‍ය ක්‍රියා වස්තුව නූපදී. හෙතෙම ශරීරය බිඳී යෑමෙන් මරණින් මතු චාතුර්මහාරාජික දෙවියන්ට සහභාගීව උපදී.
  - If the line has moved, search for: `එහි සිවු වරම් මහ රජ දරුවෝ`
- [ ] **PLK-176** · paragraph 36 (පුඤ්ඤකිරියවත්‍ථු සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3313.xml line 83](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3313.xml#L83)
  - Now: මහණෙනි, එහි සක්දෙව් රජතමෙ දානමය
  - Should be: මහණෙනි, එහි සක්දෙව් රජ තෙම දානමය
  - Why: Spelling: රජතමෙ should be රජ තෙම (Sakka the king), written like දෙව් පුත් තෙම in the next paragraphs.
  - Compare, the same construction in the next paragraph ([vagga_3313.xml line 84](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3313.xml#L84)): එහි සුයාම දෙව් පුත් තෙම
  - If the line has moved, search for: `රජතමෙ`
- [ ] **PLK-177** · paragraph 36 (පුඤ්ඤකිරියවත්‍ථු සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3313.xml line 86](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3313.xml#L86)
  - Now: නිර්මාණ රතී දෙව්ලෝ වැස්න්ට සහභාගීව
  - Should be: නිර්මාණ රතී දෙව්ලෝ වැස්සන්ට සහභාගීව
  - Why: Spelling: a letter is missing in වැස්සන්ට.
  - Compare, the same word two paragraphs above ([vagga_3313.xml line 84](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3313.xml#L84)): යාම දෙව්ලෝ වැස්සන්ට
  - If the line has moved, search for: `වැස්න්ට`
- [ ] **PLK-497** · paragraph 39 (අඨපුඤ්ඤාභි සන්‍ද සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3313.xml line 114](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3313.xml#L114)
  - Now: 9. අඨපුඤ්ඤාභි සන්‍ද සූත්‍රය
  - Should be: 9. අට්ඨපුඤ්ඤාභි සන්‍ද සූත්‍රය
  - Why: Spelling: «අඨ» should be «අට්ඨ» (eight).
  - Compare, the spelling අට්ඨ in a heading of this vagga ([vagga_3313.xml line 24](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3313.xml#L24)): අට්ඨදානවත්‍ථු
  - If the line has moved, search for: `9. අඨපුඤ්ඤාභි සන්‍ද සූත්‍රය`
- [ ] **PLK-216** · paragraph 42 (දුතිය අට්ඨඞ්ගුපොසථ සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3314.xml lines [49](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L49), [85](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L85), [138](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L138)
  - Now: මරණින් මතු නිර්මණෙ රතී දෙවියන්
  - Should be: මරණින් මතු නිර්මාණ රතී දෙවියන්
  - Why: Spelling: නිර්මණෙ should be නිර්මාණ, as earlier in the same line. The same slip stands in three suttas (8. 1. 5. 2., 8. 1. 5. 3. and 8. 1. 5. 5.).
  - Compare, same line, earlier ([vagga_3314.xml line 49](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L49)): නිර්මාණ රතී දෙවියන්ට මේ එකරෑ
  - If the line has moved, search for: `නිර්මණෙ`
- [ ] **PLK-217** · paragraph 42 (දුතිය අට්ඨඞ්ගුපොසථ සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3314.xml lines [42](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L42), [78](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L78), [131](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L131)
  - Now: වජ්ජි - මල්‍ය - වෙදි - වංග
  - Should be: වජ්ජි - මල්‍ය - චේදි - වංග
  - Why: The country after Malla is Ceti (Pāli චෙතීනං); වෙදි has a wrong first letter. Since this list uses Sanskrit forms (මත්ස්‍ය, ශුරසෙන, අශ්වක), probably චේදි (Sanskrit Cedi) was meant; චේති would also do. This translation calls the country චේතිය elsewhere. The same list in vagga\_3319.xml (line 23) has the same slip.
  - Compare, Pāli of sutta 8. 1. 5. 2. ([an-8.json line 6883](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L6883)): මල්ලානං චෙතීනං වඞ්ගානං
  - Compare, Buddha Jayanthi's Sinhala ([an-8.json line 6903](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L6903)): මල්ල ය, චෙතී ය, වඞ්ක ය
  - Compare, the country in this translation, sutta 8. 1. 3. 10. ([vagga_3312.xml line 197](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3312.xml#L197)): චේතිය රට
  - If the line has moved, search for: `වෙදි`
- [ ] **PLK-218** · paragraph 42 (දුතිය අට්ඨඞ්ගුපොසථ සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3314.xml lines [54](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L54), [90](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L90)
  - Now: මේ අතර මු.ුය, මැණික්ය
  - Should be: මේ අතර මුතුය, මැණික්ය
  - Why: Spelling: මු.ුය should be මුතුය (pearl), as in the same verse in sutta 8. 1. 5. 5.
  - Compare, the same verse, sutta 8. 1. 5. 5. ([vagga_3314.xml line 143](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L143)): මේ අතර මුතුය, මැණික්ය
  - Compare, Pāli of the verse ([an-8.json line 6984](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L6984)): මුත්තා මණි
  - If the line has moved, search for: `මු.ුය`
- [ ] **PLK-211** · paragraph 43 (විසාඛුපොසථ සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3314.xml lines [86](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L86), [139](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L139)
  - Now: මිනිසුන්ගේ යම් අවුරුදු දහසය දහසක්, පරනිර්මිත
  - Should be: මිනිසුන්ගේ යම් අවුරුදු එක්දහස් හයසීයක්, පරනිර්මිත
  - Why: Wrong number: one day and night of the Paranimmitavasavatti gods is 1,600 human years (Pāli සොළසවස්සසතානි, sixteen hundred), not 16,000. Sutta 8. 1. 5. 2. has it right; 16,000 is their life span in divine years, which the same line gives next.
  - Compare, the same sentence in sutta 8. 1. 5. 2. ([vagga_3314.xml line 50](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L50)): මිනිසුන්ගේ යම් අවුරුදු එක්දහස් හයසීයක්
  - Compare, Pāli, sutta 8. 1. 5. 2. ([an-8.json line 6965](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L6965)): මානුසකානි සොළසවස්සසතානි පරනිම්මිතවසවත්තීනං
  - If the line has moved, search for: `අවුරුදු දහසය දහසක්`
- [ ] **PLK-212** · paragraph 43 (විසාඛුපොසථ සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3314.xml lines [75](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L75), [78](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L78), [79](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L79), [80](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L80), [81](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L81), [82](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L82), [83](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L83), [84](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L84), [85](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L85), [86](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L86)
  - Now: මහණෙනි,
  - Should be: විශාඛාවෙනි,
  - Why: This sutta is spoken to Visākhā, but from the end of the eighth factor (line 75) to the end of the prose (line 86) she is addressed as මහණෙනි (monks), copied from the previous sutta. In each of these lines every මහණෙනි should be විශාඛාවෙනි (line 82 has it three times, lines 83–86 twice). The same lines in sutta 8. 1. 5. 2. (lines 40–50), spoken to the monks, are right as they are.
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta, end of the eighth factor ([an-8.json line 7062](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L7062)): එවං උපවුත්ථො ඛො විසාඛෙ
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta, the comparison ([an-8.json line 7125](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L7125)): කපණං විසාඛෙ, මානුසකං රජ්ජං
  - Compare, this sutta, line 76 ([vagga_3314.xml line 76](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L76)): “විශාඛාවෙනි, අංග අටකින් යුත් පෙහෙවස්
  - If the line has moved, search for: `මහණෙනි, දිව්‍ය සුඛය හා සසඳන කල`
- [ ] **PLK-160** · paragraph 44 (වාසෙඨුපොසත සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3314.xml line 96](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3314.xml#L96)
  - Now: 4. වාසෙඨුපොසත සූත්‍රය
  - Should be: 4. වාසෙට්ඨුපොසථ සූත්‍රය
  - Why: Spelling of the heading: the name is Vāseṭṭha (වාසෙට්ඨ, as in the sutta itself) and the observance is uposatha (ථ, not ත).
  - Compare, Pāli heading of this sutta ([an-8.json line 7201](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-8.json#L7201)): වාසෙට්ඨුපොසථ සුත්තං
